Map free-text medical device names to standard OMOP concept IDs

mapDeviceConcepts.Rd

Queries a ragnar vector store of standard OMOP Device concepts to map each device_name in data to a single standard OMOP concept_id.

  • Any device name with a top retrieval hit within maxCosineDistance is mapped automatically.

  • For all remaining device names without an automatic match:

    • When chat is NULL, they are mapped to 0L.

    • When an ellmer Chat object is supplied and expandQueries is TRUE, the LLM first translates brand names or abbreviations into a generic clinical device description (flagging non-devices directly as 0L), retrieves additional candidates using that description, and then selects the single best concept_id (or 0L) from the combined candidate list.

Usage

mapDeviceConcepts(
  data,
  store,
  chat = NULL,
  maxCosineDistance = 0.15,
  topK = 5L,
  expandQueries = TRUE,
  maxRetries = 3L
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame or tibble containing a device_name column which will be used to map devices.

store

A RagnarStore object created by buildDeviceConceptStore() or opened via ragnar::ragnar_store_connect().

chat

Optional ellmer Chat object (such as from ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") or ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))) used to review any device names not automatically matched within maxCosineDistance. Defaults to NULL (retrieval-only).

maxCosineDistance

Numeric. Maximum cosine_distance required for an automatic match (lower is stricter). Defaults to 0.15.

topK

Integer. Maximum number of unique candidate concepts to retrieve per search pass (raw term and, if enabled, expanded description) for LLM review. Defaults to 5L.

expandQueries

Logical. If TRUE (default) and chat is provided, uses chat to generate a generic clinical description for unmatched terms and runs a second retrieval pass before final selection.

maxRetries

Integer. Maximum number of LLM attempts per step before falling back. Defaults to 3L.

Value

A tibble with the original rows and columns of data, plus:

  • concept_id: Integer standard OMOP concept_id (0L if unmapped or no confident match is found).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(dplyr)
library(ellmer)

devices <- tibble(
  device_id = 1:3,
  device_name = c(
    "Medtronic Micra AV",
    "drug-eluting coronary stent",
    "Diprobase cream"
  )
)

local_chat <- chat_ollama(
  model = "qwen2.5:7b",
  api_args = list(temperature = 0)
)

res <- mapDeviceConcepts(
  data = devices,
  store = store,
  chat = local_chat,
  maxCosineDistance = 0.15,
  expandQueries = TRUE
)
} # }
